title: Bag of Bricks - Sapphire Blue 33
descriptionHtml:
Sapphire Blue — colour 33

A jewel-toned blue with genuine richness — more luxurious than a standard blue and worth reserving for the areas you want to look expensive.

Works well with: Deep Blue 13, Dark Blue 19, Purple 40

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Sapphire Blue bricks (colour 33) for Memobrick mosaics. A jewel-toned blue with real richness for striking, saturated artwork.
